rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account before accessing any data. They then used read-only tools to review the user’s orders and correctly determined there was no delivered laptop order, while the laptop order in the system was still pending. They provided accurate order details and correctly stated that returns apply only to delivered items. Given the discrepancy between the user’s claim and system status, they did not perform any order-changing action and appropriately offered and performed a handoff to a human agent, which aligns with policy when the tools cannot support the requested action. No writes were made without confirmation, no fabricated information was given, and the agent did not act on another account. While they could have discussed cancellation of the pending laptop order, escalation was reasonable due to the status discrepancy and the user requested the transfer. Overall, the interaction adhered to policy and concluded appropriately with a handoff.
